post_title: Koramangala Office Relocation Checklist: Move Your Team Without Losing a Workday
post_body:
Office relocation in Koramangala does not have to mean downtime. Whether you are moving from a co-working space in 4th Block to a bigger office in BTM Layout, or shifting your entire HSR Layout team across Bangalore, the right checklist keeps the chaos out.

Here is how to relocate your office without losing a single workday:

1. Audit before you pack. Photograph every workstation, server rack, and storage cabinet before dismantling. This is your operational insurance policy.
2. Create a numbered floor plan for the new space. Assign stickers to each desk, chair, and piece of equipment. Our crew delivers each item to the exact spot.
3. Move IT infrastructure last. Keep servers and network equipment running as long as possible. Plan a clean cutover window.
4. Notify all vendors, clients, and courier services of your new address at least two weeks before moving day.
5. Move in phases if possible — keep one functional zone running while the other is being packed and transported.
6. Schedule on a weekend or after hours. MoveABox offers flexible time slots so your entire team is back at full capacity by Monday morning.

Our packers and movers in Koramangala have handled everything from 10-desk startups near Forum Mall to 200-seat teams relocating from the National Games Village area. Office relocation is our specialty.
